text:
noah (AE): SilverLake POC is showing repeated 502s and variable first-byte latency during their integration tests. Demo in 6 hours. Can we swarm? Customer also asked for a hard spend cap.

ivy (CS): They said requests are tiny (system prompt + user ~40 tokens) and are non-streaming. Happens under steady QPS ~25rps. Have a sample req id: sl_req_20260322_1133.

manu (SRE): Quick grep of worker logs for route=silverlake-poc: seeing backend 502s with exec_ms 500-1200 and many batches size=1. Also ratelimiter shows short bursts exhausted. Snippet: 

[worker-5] route=silverlake-poc enqueue_delay_ms=110 batch_size=1 exec_ms=612 http_status=502 err="upstream_error"
[ratelimit] tenant=silverlake burst_remaining=0 refill_ms=60000

manu (SRE): Hypothesis: client retries + small batches + cache misses. Also noticed occasional prefill contention where two concurrent requests requested same system prompt and cache writes collided, causing both to miss and run full model.

dario (Infra Eng): For quick mitigation I can: 1) enable prefix_kv_cache for the common system prompt, ttl=900s; 2) reduce batch_window_ms to 8ms and cap max_batch_size=48 to favor latency; 3) temporarily raise tenant burst_tokens. Commands: 

redwoodctl cache enable --route silverlake-poc --type prefix_kv --ttl=900s
redwoodctl routes update --route silverlake-poc --set batch_window_ms=8 --set max_batch_size=48
redwoodctl tenants update --tenant silverlake --set burst_tokens=6000

trina (Security): Received security questionnaire. Quick notes: console SSO available, audit logs exportable, keys via customer KMS supported, can offer private deployment later. No immediate block for POC.

billing-bot: POC credit available. Set requested cap parameter?

noah (AE): Customer requests a $4k hard cap and daily email at 40%/80%. Can finance approve quickly?

ivy (CS): I'll request the $4k credit. We'll set alerting and auto-block if threshold reached. Also ask them to add modest client-side jitter (10ms) and avoid tight retry loops.

manu (SRE): Implemented route/cache/tenant changes. Rolling restart of 3 nodes -> ready. Observed immediate drop in 502s. After controlled replay with client jitter, batch_size=1 events reduced by 55%, median first-byte latency down from 290ms -> 85ms, 95th from 980ms -> 210ms. No 502s in 15m window.

dario (Infra Eng): Note: prefill cache race fix is rolling out to avoid duplicate writes causing simultaneous misses. If we still see rare misses, we can enable singleflight write suppression for the route.

trina (Security): Sent full questionnaire answers to ivy. Clarified logging retention and redaction knobs.

ivy (CS): Finance approved $4k POC credit; billing alerts set to noah and ivy at 40/80. billing-bot: please enforce auto-block at 100%.

billing-bot: POC credit set=4000 USD, alerts configured, auto-block enabled at 100% usage.

noah (AE): Thanks everyone  summarizing for SilverLake: enabled prefix cache, reduced batch window, temporary burst tokens and warm nodes; security questionnaire answered; $4k credit configured. Closing unless demo surfaces anything else.
